title: Permit to Dig / Excavation Permit
name: Permit to Dig / Excavation Permit
description: Breaking-ground and excavation permit covering service location, safe digging, excavation stability, inspection and reinstatement.

sections.title: PLANNING AND SERVICE INFORMATION
items: Current utility information has been obtained
Excavation limits are physically identified
Underground electrical services have been considered
Gas, water, drainage and telecom services have been considered
Overhead services and plant access are assessed
Service-owner restrictions are understood

fields.label: Utility / Service Drawing References and Dates

sections.title: LOCATING AND MARKING SERVICES
items: Suitable locating equipment has been used
Locator is function checked and suitable
Full proposed excavation area has been scanned
Detected services are marked on the ground
Trial holes / hand digging will positively identify services where required
Absence of a locator signal is not treated as proof of no services

fields.label: Scan Results / Service Positions and Depths

sections.title: SAFE EXCAVATION CONTROLS
items: Mechanical excavation limits are defined
Safe digging techniques are used near services
Exposed services are supported and protected
Spoil and plant are controlled at excavation edges
Barriers and edge protection are in place
Safe access and egress are provided
Plant and pedestrians are segregated
Water and contamination risks are assessed
Service-strike and collapse emergency arrangements are briefed

sections.title: STABILITY AND INSPECTION
items: Ground conditions and collapse risk are assessed
Suitable support or battering is provided where required
Adjacent structures and roads are considered
Excavation support follows its design
A competent person inspects before work starts
Re-inspection follows events that may affect stability

sections.title: REINSTATEMENT AND CLOSE-OUT
items: Exposed services are inspected before backfill
Backfill will not damage services
Service protection and marker systems are reinstated
Surface is safely reinstated
As-built information is updated where required
Area is safe for hand-back

fields.label: Condition of Exposed Services Before Backfill
